name: ORNA
recent: ORNA 近期没有重大企业活动，主要是一系列董事兼大股东 Sai Han Siong 的股权变动申报，他在9月至10月间多次以间接方式小额增持公司股份。公司也发布了截至2026年9月30日止季度的业绩报告。
notable: 董事兼大股东 Sai Han Siong 在2026年9月至10月间多次以间接方式增持公司股份。

risks: Sai Han Siong 在2026年10月9日申报在闭市期内有买卖公司股份的意向。

recent_en: ORNA has had no major corporate activities recently; the main developments are a series of shareholding change announcements by Director and substantial shareholder Sai Han Siong, who acquired small amounts of shares indirectly multiple times between September and October. The company also released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
notable_en: Director and substantial shareholder Sai Han Siong acquired shares indirectly multiple times between September and October 2026.
The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
risks_en: Sai Han Siong filed a notice of intention to deal in the company's shares during the closed period on 9 October 2026.
